title: All Decked Out on 30A | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: All Decked Out on 30A is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.

normalized_matching_profile.name: All Decked Out on 30A
normalized_matching_profile.description: Looking for a spacious retreat for your group? All Decked Out on 30A in Santa Rosa Beach offers everything you need for an unforgettable vacation. Tucked away on a quiet street, this home is just a short walk to the sandy shores, making it perfect for beach lovers. With 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and room to sleep up to 14 guests, it’s ideal for families or friends.On the second floor, the spacious living area welcomes you with an oversized sectional sofa, perfect for watching TV or sharing stories about your day at the beach. The fully equipped kitchen makes meal prep a breeze, featuring a coffee maker, Keurig, toaster, and microwave. Gather around the dining table that seats six, or enjoy casual meals in the eat-in kitchen, which offers seating for six more. For outdoor dining, the wraparound deck and crow’s nest provide plenty of seating and a great view.This home offers five beautifully designed bedrooms, ensuring everyone in your group has a comfortable place to unwind. Two King suites and two Queen rooms provide restful retreats, while the vibrant bunk room is perfect for younger travelers. Each bedroom comes with its own bathroom for privacy and convenience.If you’re in the mood for some friendly competition, the ground-floor game room has a full-sized pool table, TV, and even a refrigerator. Step outside to your private pool, which can be heated upon request, or fire up the BBQ grill near the pool. You’ll also appreciate the washer and dryer for keeping up with laundry during your stay. With plenty of outdoor space and seating, this home encourages relaxation, connection, and fun.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Level, Bedroom 1: 1 King bed, TV, and a private bathroom.1st Level, Bedroom 2: 1 Twin-over-Twin bunks, 2 Full beds, TV, and a private bathroom.2nd Level, Bedroom 3: 1 King bed, TV, and a private bathroom.2nd Level, Bedroom 4: 1 Queen bed, TV, and a shared bathroom.2nd Level, Bedroom 5: 1 Queen bed, TV, and a shared bathroom.Nearby Attractions:This unit puts you right where you want to be. Just a short walk from Redfish Village, you'll have easy access to some of the area's best dining, including Redfish Taco, Cowgirl Kitchen, and Blue Mountain Bakery. For even more options, Gulf Place offers fresh seafood at Shunk Gulley, casual bites at Pizza by the Sea, and a great local hangout at Papa Surf. If you’re in the mood for something sweet, Blue Mountain Creamery and Pecan Jacks are just minutes away.Beyond great food, there's plenty to explore nearby. Alvin’s Island and All Decked Out on 30A have fun finds for beachwear and souvenirs, while the intercoastal waterway offers exciting boat and jet ski rentals delivered straight to the park for a hassle-free adventure on the water. Whether you're here for the food, the shopping, or a day out on the waves, this spot makes it easy to enjoy it all.Your stay at All Decked Out on 30A comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:*Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.*Parking for 2 cars only.*The pool can be heated for an additional fee.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
